writeup.key_factor: Tyler Mahle has been a different pitcher since joining Atlanta: 1.99 ERA over nine starts plus 7 innings of 1-run ball in his playoff debut. The model prices the Braves as -101 favorites at home in an elimination game, but Pinnacle still offers +135 against a rusty Glasnow (4.46 ERA since returning from a 3-month IL stint).
writeup.risk: Mahle says the abdominal pull is a non-issue but it flared during last week's Wild Card start; Atlanta's big three (Baldwin, Acuna, Olson) are hitting .149 this postseason and Acuna is playing through knee soreness (DH today); Glasnow was elite last October (1.69 ERA) despite a shaky career postseason line.

writeup.key_factor: Nick Martinez broke out as a full-time starter (3.10 ERA, 1.09 WHIP over 180 innings, 2026 All-Star) and the model still gets Tampa Bay at +116 fair against a Yankees team missing Aaron Judge and starting a pitcher the coaching staff already put on a short leash. Pinnacle offers +147.
writeup.risk: Max Fried is an ace when right (2.80 ERA, 0.99 WHIP) and was sharp in the Wild Card round (6 IP, 1 R); his career postseason ERA is 5.31 but the Yankees' bullpen is fully rested behind him (Cole, Rodon, Bednar available); Tampa Bay must win on the road to complete the sweep.
